display_long_description:
CLICK CLACK MIXED REALITY

The only adult mixed reality FPS on Quest. Your home. Real weapons. Digital blood on your walls. No mercy.  

No pew pew lasers and cartoon portals. Click Clack MR brings brutal, tactical combat into your actual living space — walls, hallways, furniture and all. The enemy is in your house.  
This is Mixed Reality built for people who don't want easy.
🔫 Tactical Breach & Clear — Stack up on real doors, sweep real rooms, neutralize threats hiding behind your actual couch.
🎯 Hostage Rescue — Breach, identify, and execute under pressure. Some enemies blend in. Make the wrong call and face the consequences.
💀 Shoot-Out Survival — Endless wave mode. No respawn timers. No hand-holding. Be the last one standing or start over.
🦆 Hunt Ducks/Target Practice — Sharpen your aim in your real space before the real fight begins.
Realistic weapons. High difficulty. Gore enabled.
Built for adult players who want their mixed reality to have weight.
Early Access —  Updates drop fast.
